'''Tavri''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tavri worked with the [[Detective/Legends|detective]] [[Nim Bola]] for a time.

==Biography==
Tavri left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] at an early age and wandered the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. He spent most of his time in the [[The fringe|Fringe]] to avoid being caught up in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A mishap with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] led him to being locked up in a prison where Bola was investigating a prison break. The detective made a deal for Tavri's freedom and the Twi'lek became his loyal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]].<ref name="AJ3" />

Tavri was with Bola on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when the detective was stalked by a pair of bounty hunters. The Twi'lek help Bola ambush and kill the two hunters in an alley in Mos Eisley. Later, he kept watch as Bola made a deal to sell the droid [[R2-Z1]]. Tavri noticed that they were being observed and made his way to the top of the docking bay where he found a pair of [[Ossan]]s guarding a [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] who was spying on the meeting. Tavri managed to stun the Ossans and kill the Jenet before they could report to the Imperials.<ref name="AJ3" />
